subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled CodeMirror-style editor dependency for the Control UI raw config editor, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75466 be repaired as the landing path?
rationale: Current source proves the textarea gap, but accepting a new editor dependency and changing the raw config editing UX is a maintainer product decision rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75466 or a replacement PR only after it is rebased, preserves reveal-to-edit and save behavior, and includes browser proof for edit, lint, format, fold, and save flows.

options.title: Keep textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency/product surface until raw config editing has higher priority or a lighter existing component is chosen.

options.title: Request a design note first
options.body: Keep this open but require a short maintainer comparison of editor dependency, JSON5 formatting semantics, sensitive-value handling, and bundle impact before more code work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75466 or a replacement PR only after it is rebased, preserves reveal-to-edit and save behavior, and includes browser proof for edit, lint, format, fold, and save flows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied by history to the current reveal-to-edit raw config flow and is the clearest owner for the product/compatibility decision around replacing it.
